HomePage.heroText: Classical acupuncture and modern laser therapy for natural, lasting vitality.

Philosophy.pinyin: TÒNG ZÉ BÙ TŌNG, BÙ TŌNG ZÉ TÒNG
Philosophy.line1: Where there is pain, there is no free flow.
Philosophy.line2: Where there is free flow, there is no pain.
Philosophy.explanation: In Traditional Chinese Medicine, discomfort and illness arise when Qi (vital energy) and blood become stagnant. Acupuncture gently resolves these blockages to restore harmony.

Recognition.eyebrow: WHAT YOUR BODY IS ASKING FOR
Recognition.title: Symptoms rarely exist in isolation.
Recognition.paragraph1: Sometimes you know exactly what is bothering you. Sometimes you just feel that your body is no longer functioning as it should.
Recognition.paragraph2: Pain that keeps returning. A body that feels perpetually tense. Poor sleep, low energy, or persistent symptoms for which you have already tried everything.
Recognition.paragraph3: In Traditional Chinese Medicine, we do not only look at the symptom itself, but at the whole picture.
Recognition.paragraph4: Where does the imbalance come from? And what does your body need to restore its natural equilibrium?

Help.title: Treatment begins with understanding what your body is facing.
Help.intro: Acupuncture is used in my practice for a wide variety of symptoms and concerns. Every treatment is tailored to the individual and the situation.

pain.title: Pain & tension
pain.description: Back, neck, and shoulder complaints, muscle and joint pain, headaches, and other forms of physical tension.

stress.title: Stress & sleep
stress.description: A body that is constantly "on", difficulty relaxing, restlessness, or trouble sleeping.

energy.title: Energy & recovery
energy.description: Fatigue, low energy, or the feeling that your body struggles to recover.

digestion.title: Stomach & digestion
digestion.description: Digestive issues, such as bloating, abdominal discomfort, or an unsettled digestive system.

gender.title: Women & men
gender.description: Symptoms related to menstruation, menopause, and other physical changes.

smoking.title: Quitting smoking & vaping
smoking.description: Targeted laser acupuncture and auricular acupuncture to support breaking the habit and managing cravings.

acupuncture.title: Balance begins with personalized care
acupuncture.description: Every body tells its own story. Grounded in traditional Chinese medicine, we address the root cause of imbalance, not just the symptoms.
acupuncture.alt: Acupuncture treatment in peaceful clinic room

laser.title: Modern innovation, ancient wisdom
laser.description: Needle-free, precise and gentle. Highly effective for breaking nicotine addiction and restoring energetic flow.
